title: For a representable morphism, separatedness is equivalent to the diagonal being a closed immersion, universally closed or proper
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a morphism of algebraic stacks representable by algebraic spaces, separatedness and the three diagonal conditions (closed immersion, universally closed, proper) are equivalent (author lemma at source lines 451-461, label lemma-representable-separated-diagonal-closed). The proof (source lines 463-496) presents the morphism by algebraic spaces, uses the base change formula for the diagonal and the covering criterion to move every condition to the presentation, applies the corresponding equivalence for algebraic spaces, and closes the circle by identifying the diagonal of an arbitrary base change with a base change of the diagonal (proof lines 463-495). The reduction through the presentation and the two implications are the content. H3.
